semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Explanation of the $51 million increase in net income for IBRD, attributing it to unrealized mark-to-market gains on non-trading portfolios and increased revenue on interest-earning assets, partially offset by Board-approved transfers.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Covers the causal explanation segment linking the comparative net income figures between FY 25 YTD and the same period in FY 24. It encapsulates the specific drivers (unrealized gains/losses, interest revenue) and offsets (transfers/expenses) that constitute the variance analysis.
